chapter: Early music and bands on the coast
title: Dance halls, the five-minute slow drag and dime dances
summary: He explains the dance-hall pricing at the Music Box, Budweiser and Levita, and the popular five-minute slow drag.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, I'll tell you, uh, you see playing the blues at that time, it was mostly slow numbers, you know, and, uh, they could tell more about you playing the blues than they could by you playing any other numbers because the blues was always slow. And just like when I started playing at the, uh, Budweiser and Levita.
You remember Budweiser and Levita? Well, I wasn't there. That's before my time.
You never was on Crown Rating Canal at the, uh... Music Box? Yeah.
No, I wasn't there. I heard about it. I heard about it. Even I can't heard about it. You see, I wasn't here then. I'm not from New Orleans. No, I know you're not.

So, I wasn't here then. Well, anyway, well, it's been a long time back. A while. Well, anyway, uh, they had their five minutes slow drag and, uh, and they had the Foxtrot and this and that, you know, at the Music Box, Budweiser and the Levita and all like that. Well, it, that five minutes slow drag was a slow, slow number. You used to get 15 cents, pay 15 cents for a dance. In other words, if you're gonna, if the guys... What happened to the dine-la dance? The what? The dine-la dance. Well, that was the same thing. You pay a dine, you pay a dine, well, I mean, it was just a fast number and all like that. Well, no, when they'd, uh, ask for a five minutes slow drag, but it was 15 cents, you see. And some numbers, well, you'd play a fast, fast number. It was a nickel because you only had time just to get up there by the time you give that nickel to Bambi and stop that fast number, you see. And, uh, but most of the dine-la dance. And when they asked for a five minutes slow drag, oh, they'd pack the house like that. The house would be packed because they could stay out there with those girls and they'd be out there for five minutes dancing and they'd ask for five, for more five minutes slow drag than they would ask for anything else. Well, it was easier on musicians anyway, wasn't it? Yeah, it was. It was easier.
